tickerText: [TENNIS] Monday ATP 500 semis: in Beijing, Novak Djokovic (d. Alexander Zverev 4-6, 6-4, 6-4, still 32-0 there) meets Daniil Medvedev, and Alex de Minaur — up to 9th in the Race to Turin — meets Hubert Hurkacz; in Tokyo, defending champ Carlos Alcaraz, through when Denis Shapovalov retired, plays qualifier Jaume Munar, and Jiri Lehecka meets Valentin Vacherot • [SQUASH] Egyptian sweep at the Champion Fiberglass Swedish Open on Stockholm's GIH glass court: Fayrouz Aboelkheir beat Georgina Kennedy 11-5, 11-4, 11-3 and Mohamad Zakaria beat Joel Makin 11-6, 11-6, 8-11, 11-2, in the first women's PSA World Tour event staged in Sweden • [BADMINTON] VICTOR BWF World Junior Team Championships open Monday in Cairo — only the second Suhandinata Cup in Africa — with 47 teams at Cairo Stadium Indoor Halls (Oct. 5–10) and a new best-of-three relay to 55 before individual play Oct. 11–17 • [PICKLEBALL] Championship Sunday at the Rate Las Vegas Open (first serve 10 a.m. PT, PickleballTV and Tennis Channel): five best-of-three, 1,000-point finals at Darling Tennis Center. Anna Leigh Waters, skipping singles, entered the day two doubles titles from career PPA title No. 200 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash main draw continues Monday at Shougang Park in Beijing, a $2.05 million season finale through Oct. 11, after Sunday's round-of-64 singles and mixed-doubles round of 24

newsItems.title: Beijing and Tokyo Semis Are Set
newsItems.excerpt: Novak Djokovic beat Alexander Zverev 4-6, 6-4, 6-4 to stay 32-0 in Beijing and meet Daniil Medvedev on Monday, while Alex de Minaur faces Hubert Hurkacz after climbing to ninth in the Race to Turin. In Tokyo, Carlos Alcaraz plays Jaume Munar and Jiri Lehecka plays Valentin Vacherot.

newsItems.title: Cairo Opens the World Junior Teams
newsItems.excerpt: The Suhandinata Cup starts Oct. 5 in Cairo with 47 teams, only the second time the BWF World Junior Team Championships have been held in Africa. The new relay is best of three sets to 55, each set five 11-point matches, before individual play begins Oct. 11.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Championship Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Rate Las Vegas Open reaches its five best-of-three finals on Oct. 4 at Darling Tennis Center. Anna Leigh Waters, who is not playing singles, entered Championship Sunday two doubles titles away from career PPA title No. 200.

newsItems.title: China Smash Main Draw Continues
newsItems.excerpt: After Sunday's singles round of 64 and mixed-doubles round of 24, the $2.05 million WTT China Smash continues Monday at Shougang Park in Beijing. The season finale runs through Oct. 11.
